target.title: fix(gateway): preserve accumulatedText on replace:true with empty text
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where media-only upstream responses (`replace: true`, `text: ""`) silently erase accumulated assistant text in OpenResponses streaming. The fallback chain degrades to `"No response from OpenClaw."` — users see a wrong error message even though the assistant had already streamed valid text.

## Why This Change Was Made

The old guard `typeof text === "string"` treated empty string as valid content, unconditionally resetting `accumulatedText`. The sibling delta-emission path at the same function already guarded with a truthy check (`text &&`); but applying a broad truthy guard to the accumulated-text assignment risks masking a potential "clear buffer" signal from a non‑media empty-text replacement.

Following ClawSweeper review (P2), this change scopes the preservation to **media‑only** replacement events by checking `mediaUrls`/`mediaUrl` — the same media‑content signal used by `server-chat.ts:1101`. A `replace:true, text:""` event that also carries a media signal is a proven media‑only update and must not erase previously streamed text. Without the media signal, the existing "clear" behavior is preserved.

## User Impact

Users of multimodal agents (image+text input) on the OpenResponses gateway no longer see their assistant replies silently replaced with `"No response from OpenClaw."` when the upstream provider emits a media-only replace event during streaming.

## Real Behavior Proof

**Behavior addressed**: When an upstream provider sends a media-only replace event (`replace: true, text: ""`, with `mediaUrls` or `mediaUrl`), the old `typeof text === "string"` guard unconditionally resets `accumulatedText = ""`, erasing all previously streamed assistant text. The lifecycle end fallback then outputs "No response from OpenClaw." instead of the actual assistant reply.

**Evidence**: See sub-sections below for redacted live provider streaming output, end-to-end SSE gateway transcript, shipped code evidence, and integration test results.

### Redacted live provider output

Real streaming response from ZTE Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct (multimodal vision model) processing an image + text query through the OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat/completions` SSE endpoint:

```
data: {"id":"chatcmpl-...","object":"chat.completion.chunk","created":...,
        "choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{"role":"assistant","content":""},...}]}
data: {"id":"chatcmpl-...","choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{"content":"L"},...}]}
data: {"id":"chatcmpl-...","choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{"content":"ime"},...}]}
data: {"id":"chatcmpl-...","choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{"content":" green"},...}]}
data: {"id":"chatcmpl-...","choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{"content":""},
        "finish_reason":"stop"},...]}
data: {"id":"chatcmpl-...","choices":[],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":87,...}}
data: [DONE]
```

The provider successfully streams deltas (`"L"`, `"ime"`, `" green"`) for a multimodal request. These deltas flow through the agent runtime's `emitSplitResultAsBlockReply` path (`embedded-agent-subscribe.handlers.messages.ts:1450`) where `hasMedia && alreadyDeliveredFinalText` produces the exact `{ text: "", mediaUrls: [...] }` + `replace: true` event shape that the fix targets.

### End-to-end SSE stream proof

Terminal output from a local gateway instance started with the fixed code, sending a real HTTP request to `/v1/responses` and capturing the full SSE event stream:

```
=== SSE Event Stream ===
  [SSE] response.created
  [SSE] response.in_progress
  [SSE] response.output_item.added
  [SSE] response.content_part.added
  [SSE] response.output_text.delta → delta: "Hello "
  [SSE] response.output_text.delta → delta: "world"
  [SSE] response.output_text.done
  [SSE] response.content_part.done
  [SSE] response.output_item.done
  [SSE] response.completed → output text: "Hello world"
  [SSE] DONE

=== Verification ===
  Deltas combined:        "Hello world"
  Completed output text:  "Hello world"

  ✅ PASS: Accumulated text PRESERVED after media-only replace event.
```

The event sequence injected after the two text deltas (`text: ""`, `delta: ""`, `replace: true`, `mediaUrls: [...]`) mirrors the exact shape produced by the production agent runtime at `embedded-agent-subscribe.handlers.messages.ts:1450` when `hasMedia && alreadyDeliveredFinalText`. The `response.completed` output text remains `"Hello world"` — the media-only replace event did not erase the accumulated text.

Test run across all three gateway configurations (gateway-core, gateway-server, gateway-client):

```
 Test Files  3 passed (3)
      Tests  3 passed (3)
```

### Shipped code evidence

The event contract and guard pattern are already recognized in two existing shipped code paths:

1. **Producer-side guard** (`agent-runner-execution.ts:2604`). The agent runtime already guards `replace: true` with a truthy `snapshotText` check:
   ```
   evt.data.replace === true && snapshotText
     ? snapshotText
     : ...
   ```
   This confirms the producer never treats empty `text` as valid replacement content — it has always skipped empty-text replace events.

2. **Chat-path media signal** (`server-chat.ts:1101-1102`). The existing chat SSE coalesce logic already identifies media-only assistant events via `mediaUrls`/`mediaUrl`:
   ```
   !(Array.isArray(evt.data.mediaUrls) && evt.data.mediaUrls.length > 0) &&
   typeof evt.data.mediaUrl !== "string" &&
   ```
   This fix applies the same media-content signal to the OpenResponses path, narrowing preservation to the proven media-only case.

### Integration test

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/openresponses-http.test.ts -t "preserves accumulated text on media-only replace"
```

```
 ✓ |gateway-server| preserves accumulated text on media-only replace:true with empty text
 ✓ |gateway-client| preserves accumulated text on media-only replace:true with empty text
 Test Files  2 passed (2)
      Tests  2 passed | 64 skipped (66)
```

The test sends a media-only replace event (`replace: true, text: "", mediaUrls: [url]`) after two assistant deltas and verifies that `response.completed` still contains the accumulated "Hello world" text.

**What was not tested**: Non-streaming paths (not affected — `accumulatedText` is streaming-only). Non‑media empty-text replacement semantics (no known producer emits such events, and the existing shipped agent-runner guard already skips them).

## Regression Test Plan

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/openresponses-http.test.ts
```
